title: phyteuma orbiculare subsp. austriacum
intro: Phyteuma orbiculare subsp. austriacum, commonly known as Austrian scabious, is a plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine, and research has revealed its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Austrian scabious include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and possess anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties. The bioactive constituents of Phyteuma orbiculare subsp. austriacum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
